messages.text: No charges against Carse after police close alleged assault investigation

metadata.summary: Brydon Carse will not face any charges after Derbyshire Police closed their investigation into an alleged assault following an incident involving the England cricketer at a nightclub in Derby.
metadata.content: Brydon Carse: No charges against England cricketer after police close investigation into alleged assault at nightclub | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Brydon Carse: No charges against England cricketer after police close investigation into alleged assault at nightclub Derbyshire Police have ended their investigation into an alleged assault incident which involved England and Durham cricketer Brydon Carse; Carse, who has played for Durham in the County Championship during the investigation over the last month, will not face any charges Friday 18 September 2026 19:25, UK Image: Brydon Carse will not face any charges after an investigation Brydon Carse will not face any charges after Derbyshire Police closed their investigation into an alleged assault following an incident involving the England cricketer at a nightclub in Derby. Last month, Carse was handcuffed outside a nightclub in Derby and missed the second and third Tests of England's series against Pakistan. The 31-year-old was celebrating with Durham players after their win at Derbyshire in the County Championship and was also seen talking to team-mate Matthew Potts with former England captain Ben Stokes also pictured in the background. messages.text: Gabriel edging closer to Man Utd exit as Barca and Real talks advance

metadata.summary: Barcelona and Real Madrid are in transfer talks to sign Manchester United youngster JJ Gabriel.
metadata.content: JJ Gabriel edging closer to Manchester United exit amid Barcelona talks about a potential move for the forward | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Transfer JJ Gabriel edging closer to Manchester United exit amid Barcelona talks about a potential move for the forward JJ Gabriel, 15, has made it clear he wants to leave Man Utd and has asked to be de-registered to become a free agent; Barcelona and Real Madrid talks advancing, PSG and Bayern also interested in the forward Danyal Khan Sky Sports News Reporter @DanyalHKhan Friday 18 September 2026 20:35, UK Image: JJ Gabriel could be set to depart Manchester United Barcelona and Real Madrid are in transfer talks to sign Manchester United youngster JJ Gabriel. The 15-year-old and his family are currently in Barcelona, where discussions with the Catalan club and their LaLiga rivals are advancing. PSG and Bayern Munich also remain interested in his signature. Gabriel and his team lodged a request earlier this week to leave United. The club's leadership have been hopeful they can persuade the young star to stay at the club as he is contracted until the end of the season, but it now looks increasingly likely he will move away from Old Trafford. messages.text: Somerset title hopes suffer major blow in Yorkshire defeat as Notts also lose

metadata.summary: Somerset's hopes of becoming county champions for the first time in their history took a major blow as they collapsed to a costly defeat at the hands of Yorkshire.
metadata.content: County Championship: Somerset's title hopes hit badly in Yorkshire defeat as Notts also miss out to leave Warwickshire in command | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content County Championship: Somerset's title hopes hit badly in Yorkshire defeat as Notts also miss out to leave Warwickshire in command Somerset lose leadership of Division One to Warwickshire heading into the final round of matches after hugely-costly 185-run defeat to Yorkshire at Headingley; Somerset at home to Surrey, while Warwickshire host Leicestershire in final title-deciding matches from September 24 Friday 18 September 2026 14:39, UK Image: Yorkshire players congratulate Adam Lyth (l) for taking a catch from the bowling of Ben Coad to dismiss Somerset's James Rew (SWpix.com) Somerset's hopes of becoming county champions for the first time in their history took a major blow as they collapsed to a costly defeat at the hands of Yorkshire. Top of the County Championship Division One table heading into the penultimate round of matches, Somerset saw rivals Warwickshire wrap up a two-day victory against Essex but failed to keep pace at Headingley. Chasing 287 - the highest score of the match - they were bundled out for 101 on the final day. Resuming on 73-3 they collapsed horribly as their final seven wickets fell for 25 runs in less than 13 overs.
